intro: Turkmenistan is a desert country with ancient Silk Road cities and one of the world's most closed governments.

chapters.title: Ancient oases
text: Over 4,000 years ago the Bronze Age culture of Margiana built walled towns like Gonur Depe. Later, Merv became one of the largest cities in the world, a jewel of the Seljuk Empire, until the Mongols destroyed it in 1221.
Nisa was a capital of the Parthian Empire that rivalled Rome.

chapters.title: Turkmen tribes and Russia
text: Turkmen tribes lived as nomads and horse breeders, famous for their Akhal-Teke horses. Russia conquered the region in the 1880s after the battle of Geok Tepe.
It became a Soviet republic in 1924.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Turkmenistan became independent in 1991. Saparmurat Niyazov ruled with a huge personality cult, naming months after himself. After his death in 2006 Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov took over, and in 2022 his son Serdar became president.
